foodmood.configuration.title: Food Mood Settings
foodmood.configuration.cravingsPerDay.to: Number of food cravings assigned each day
foodmood.configuration.automaticFoodDete: Automatically detect foods with positive hunger values and add them to the pool. If false, cravings will only be taken from addFoods.
foodmood.configuration.addFoods.tooltip: Item IDs added to the pool
foodmood.configuration.removeFoods.toolt: Item IDs excluded from the pool. Removals always take precedence over additions.
foodmood.configuration.rewardEffect.tool: Effect ID of the reward. Invalid effects fall back to "foodmood:satisfied". Changes apply on the next in-game day.
foodmood.configuration.rewardEffectLevel: Level of the reward effect, expressed as an integer
foodmood.configuration.satisfiedSpeedBon: Satisfied effect movement speed bonus per level. 0.10 means +10%.
foodmood.configuration.showInventoryClou: Show current cravings in the inventory screen
foodmood.configuration.showHudIcon.toolt: Show a cloud next to the hunger bar while you have a craving
Move your inventory cloud horizontally in GUI pixels. Positive moves right, negative moves left.
Move your inventory cloud vertically in GUI pixels. Positive moves down, negative moves up.
foodmood.configuration.hudOffsetX.toolti: Move your HUD icon horizontally in GUI pixels. Positive moves right, negative moves left.
foodmood.configuration.hudOffsetY.toolti: Move your HUD icon vertically in GUI pixels. Positive moves down; negative moves up.
